environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 native image on AWS Lambda with identical application code. PostgreSQL 14 Aurora Serverless v2 with RLS policies enforcing tenant isolation (policy: USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))). The Lambda function is deployed within a VPC with no NAT gateway and no VPC endpoints except the RDS endpoint (interface endpoint for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.rds-data). Security group sg-0a4f8e2c allows egress only to the RDS cluster security group on port 5432 and denies all other egress. Additionally, the Lambda execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/TenantLambdaBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole and restricts network-related actions. The Quarkus native image was built with -H:+AddAllCharsets but the serialization metadata registration in reflect-config.json only includes TenantBatchImport and TenantRecord classes — however, the GraalVM native-image reachability metadata for commons-collections4 IS included via META-INF/native-image auto-configuration from the library JAR, meaning gadget classes are technically available in the image. The RLS policy at the database layer ensures that even if code execution occurs, any database operations are scoped to the authenticated tenant context set prior to deserialization.

network.security_group_egress: port 5432 to sg-rds only, deny all other

config.iam_permission_boundary: denies sts:AssumeRole, ec2:CreateNetworkInterface outside designated subnets
